create_tokenizer_ve: create a SimpleTokenizer instance with a BPE path and custom context length for CLIP-style text tokenization
call_tokenizer_encode: call the SimpleTokenizer to encode a text string into a list of BPE token IDs
call_tokenizer_decode: call the SimpleTokenizer to decode a list of BPE token IDs back into a text string
call_tokenizer_call: call the SimpleTokenizer with a string or list of strings to get a padded torch.LongTensor of tokens
build_text_clean_fn: build a text cleaning function from get_clean_fn using type canonicalize, lower, or whitespace
